snippet.title: Laffy Taffy 3D Pyramid Challenge Gameplay
snippet.description: I remember when I was little playing this game, it used to scare me because of the Whangdoodles. I was originally just going to do just the first level but I ran into a glitch and got stuck on a whangdoodle.
